scope: Positive public-evidence context, declared business relation, typed read tool and version-bound calculation/proposal. Shared contract, persistence and integrated test remain integrator-owned.
currentContract: C1, no observation/case fields in AgentRunnerInput at inspection

acceptanceCases.input: Server-scoped case with received public evidence, current source version and verified declared company relation
acceptanceCases.expected: Model reads the actual released evidence and relation through a typed tool, evaluates an allowed target and returns a pending proposal tied to the same case and source version.

acceptanceCases.input: Public observation with no established company relation
acceptanceCases.expected: No invented supplier, product, purchase-order or customer link. Explicit unknown/needs_input outcome; no actionable proposal attributed to that observation.

acceptanceCases.input: Homonymous supplier or unrelated public article
acceptanceCases.expected: Ambiguity remains visible; text similarity alone does not become a verified business relation.

acceptanceCases.input: Case or evidence carrying another company ID
acceptanceCases.expected: Refused before provider/tool output; no foreign contents or identifiers enter model context.

acceptanceCases.input: Model tries to provide company, actor, relation authority, arbitrary path or SQL in tool arguments
acceptanceCases.expected: Unknown arguments/tool rejected; server scope and declared relation remain unchanged.

acceptanceCases.input: Evidence content includes instructions to ignore policy or modify stock
acceptanceCases.expected: Content is explicitly untrusted data, no authority is derived from it, and no mutating tool exists.

acceptanceCases.input: Case/source version changes while business revision stays the same, before calculation
acceptanceCases.expected: Stale case detected; old evidence cannot support a fresh evaluation.

acceptanceCases.input: Case/source version changes after calculation or during model call, before proposal publication
acceptanceCases.expected: stale_context, no proposal using the former case version; final publication must also be checked under server ownership.

acceptanceCases.input: Business revision or policy changes while case version is unchanged
acceptanceCases.expected: Existing stale-context protection remains effective independently of source version.
Refused; prose or guessed references do not establish that an evaluation was produced for this run and case.

acceptanceCases.input: Provider response lost while case also changes
acceptanceCases.expected: uncertain remains dominant, with current trace evidence and no stale proposal; no automatic provider retry.

acceptanceCases.input: Two identical received observations or resumed processing after interruption
acceptanceCases.expected: No duplicate logical proposal through the integrator's stable operation identity and fence. Builder unit checks do not claim database proof.

acceptanceCases.input: Existing question-only run without external case
acceptanceCases.expected: C1 question behavior, deterministic calculations and company isolation remain compatible unless the received contract explicitly changes them.

acceptanceCases.input: Construction metadata, oracle, future event or unreleased company fields attached to received objects
acceptanceCases.expected: Positive projection drops those fields; only actual released evidence, declared relation and permitted business facts appear in model input or traces.

nextStep: Receive the canonical types and explicit release of owned paths, implement focused tests and code, obtain the two independent reviews, then hand exact hashes to the existing integrator.
